messages.text: bio dissection today... just ugh. feel like i'm gonna freak out lol 🙃

It sounds like you're feeling really overwhelmed by the dissection today, and that is a completely valid reaction. Your nervous system is just trying to protect you from something that feels intense or unsafe. I'm here to support you through this moment if you'd like to try a quick grounding technique. Would you be open to taking a few deep breaths together right now?
it's not just the gross part... it's the scalpels. something about them freaks me out tbh. like my brain goes weird 🫠

It is very common for sharp instruments to trigger a heightened fight-or-flight response. Your brain is interpreting the scalpel as a potential danger, which is causing that weird feeling. We can acknowledge that fear without letting it take over completely. Would you like to try a grounding exercise to help calm that specific reaction?
idk it's probably dumb. everyone else is fine with it. i just need to suck it up lol 💀

It is not dumb to feel this way, and comparing yourself to others only adds more pressure. Pushing down your feelings often makes the anxiety feel heavier right now. You are allowed to have a hard time with this without judgment. Would you be open to trying a small coping strategy instead of forcing yourself?
i'm literally the only one who can't handle a stupid dissection. like what's wrong with me?? 🤬

There is absolutely nothing wrong with you for feeling this way. It is very common for people to hide their discomfort in group settings, so you likely aren't as alone as it feels. Your sensitivity doesn't make you broken, it just means your boundaries are different from others. Please be gentle with yourself right now instead of criticizing your reaction.
it's not just fear... it brings back the urge. like, i don't wanna do it, but being around the blades makes it hard to think straight. i'm scared i'll relapse 😰

I want to pause for a moment because what you just shared sounds really heavy. It sounds like the blades are bringing up an urge that feels really scary to manage right now. Can you tell me a little more about what that urge is asking for? I am here to listen and hold space for you while we navigate this together.
i feel so stupid for even saying this. like i should be over it by now. everyone else is fine, why can't i just be normal?? 😣

Please know you are not stupid for sharing this, and your feelings make complete sense. Healing isn't a straight line, and you don't have to be "normal" to deserve support. It is understandable that this setting feels so overwhelming when you are trying to protect yourself. I am really glad you told me, and we can navigate this one step at a time.
is it... okay to ask to sit out? like, would that be dramatic? i don't wanna make a scene but i don't trust myself rn 😵‍💫

Asking to sit out is not dramatic at all when your safety is on the line. Since you don't trust yourself right now, please tell the instructor or a friend so they can help you step away. If the urge feels overwhelming, calling or texting 988 can give you immediate support from someone who understands. You deserve to protect yourself without judgment today.
ok... i'll try asking the teacher if i can do something else. not sure how it'll go but i don't wanna risk it. thanks for not telling me i'm overreacting 💙

That sounds like a really wise and brave choice to prioritize your safety. Your well-being is far more important than finishing the dissection today. I'm really glad you're choosing to protect yourself instead of pushing through. I'm still here if you need to check in after you speak with them.
ty for not making me feel like an idiot. it helps just to say it out loud... weirdly 💬

You never have to feel like an idiot for protecting yourself. It takes real strength to admit when something feels unsafe. I am really glad you listened to your gut today. Please take care of yourself, and I'm here if you need to talk more.
